podcast.title: Drum Machine Pioneer
podcast.body: Roland is credited with inventing the TR-808 drum machine in 1980, followed shortly after by the more famous TR-909. The TR-909 is described as the first professional drum machine capable of complex functions, allowing DJs to generate their own rhythmic sequences. "rolan en 1980, inventa la TR808, aunque la famosa es la TR909."

podcast.title: Electronic Music Giant
podcast.body: Roland is an electronic music giant, founded by Ikutaro Kakehashi, who previously founded Ace Tone. "founded by Ikitaro Kakahashi, who would later go on to found Roland, the electronic music giant."
